pr.title: refactor(gallery): extract gallery scanning and media helpers into gallery_scan.py
pr.body:
Closes #521

## Summary

Moves the gallery-scan/media helpers out of `app.py` into a new sibling module `gallery_scan.py`. Pure refactor.
pr.diff:
diff --git a/gallery_scan.py b/gallery_scan.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/gallery_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Gallery scanning and media helpers extracted from app.py."""
+
+import os
+
+GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT = int(os.environ.get("GALLERY_SCAN_LIMIT", "200"))
+
+def _app():
+    import app
+    return app
+
+def sanitize_rel_path(rel):
+    return os.path.normpath(rel)
